correctness.rationale: Decomposed elements by least homogeneous degree 1..4. Nonzero linear parts conjugate via invertible coordinate automorphism to x (rank pair 6,3). Quadratic component matrix [[beta,alpha],[gamma,beta]] has determinant beta²-alpha gamma; leading quotient/socle give rank=2+rank M, square rank=0/1. The nonzero conic has q²-1 triples, each q³ higher-degree completions. Cubic leading rank2, quartic rank1, sum q^8. Independent exact Gaussian elimination of ALL 6561 F3 augmentation elements gives rank pairs (0,0):1,(1,0):2,(2,0):24,(3,0):216,(4,1):486,(6,3):5832.
